title: ChatGPT Truth Mode
description:
marketwithmark.com

Most people use AI to get answers. Power users use AI to challenge their assumptions.

ChatGPT's new Truth Mode pushes back, questions weak logic, and helps you find blind spots instead of just agreeing with everything you say.

If you're using AI for business, content, or decision-making, this might be one of the most valuable features released yet.
